title: Reactivation confirmation from the part dialog has one line
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REACT1-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL REACT1 PART), is tracked at {Location-A} and is inactive.
custom_steps:
1. On the Inactive tab search {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Pick Part Status "Active" and click Save.
  3. Read the confirmation.
  4. Click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Titled "Activate part?", it shows "{Part-A} {Description-A}", then "This part can be added to new work again." and nothing more (no "Existing records…" line and no "Stock, cost of goods…" line), then the "Note (Optional)" field.
  • Step 4: {Part-A} stays on the Inactive tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R7, S10-R4, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.7 (Bringing it back), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R7: “For a reactivation from the part dialog, the confirmation states "This part can be added to new work again." and nothing more.”
  • S10-R4: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. Raised from the part dialog, it opens with the part number followed by the description, as they stand in the form, with spaces before and after removed.”
